tagline.en: Query MySQL with a scoped account

description.zh: 自定义市场源示例：通过 DBHub 连接 MySQL。DSN 由安装时输入，建议使用只读账号。
description.en: Custom-source example: connect to MySQL through DBHub. The DSN is entered at install time; prefer a read-only account.

description.zh: 形如 mysql://user:pass@host:3306/db；会写入本机 profile
description.en: e.g. mysql://user:pass@host:3306/db; stored in the local profile

reasons.zh: 可执行任意 SQL（含写操作）
reasons.en: Can execute arbitrary SQL, including writes

reasons.zh: 连接串含密码并写入 profile
reasons.en: The DSN contains a password and is stored in the profile

note.zh: 示例：自定义市场源里的 MySQL 预设。建议用只读账号；DBHub 也支持 --readonly。
note.en: Example MySQL preset in a custom market source. Prefer a read-only account; DBHub also supports --readonly.

tagline.zh: 用官方参考服务器验证连通性
tagline.en: Validate connectivity with the official reference server

description.zh: 自定义市场源示例：官方 Everything 参考服务器，用来验证市场源安装、工具列表与 smoke。
description.en: Custom-source example: the official Everything reference server to validate source install, tool listing and smoke.

reasons.zh: get-env 会返回进程环境变量

note.zh: 示例：无 key 预设 + smoke 的写法。
note.en: Example: a key-free preset with a smoke.

tagline.zh: 远程 Streamable HTTP 市场源示例

description.zh: 自定义市场源示例：远程 streamable-http 端点，key 通过 {{input}} 模板拼进 URL。
description.en: Custom-source example: a remote streamable-http endpoint with the key templated into the URL.

description.zh: 从 tavily.com 获取；会随 URL 写入 profile
description.en: Get one at tavily.com; stored in the profile inside the URL

reasons.zh: 查询内容会发送到 Tavily 云端
reasons.en: Queries are sent to Tavily’s cloud

reasons.zh: API key 会写入本机配置
reasons.en: The API key is stored locally

note.zh: 示例：远程 URL 预设（无需 npx）；注意当前 schema 不支持 HTTP headers，需要 Authorization 的远程服务无法用这种方式表达。
note.en: Example of a remote URL preset (no npx). Note the current schema has no HTTP headers, so remotes that need Authorization cannot be expressed this way.
